businessPurpose: Prevent duplicate customer numbers and avoid overwriting a customer that may already have dependencies, while keeping the first customer route realistic and bookworthy.

smartDecision.whyNow: The first realistic customer cannot be created as U-CUST-100 because that number already exists. A read-first dependency check is required before any conversion or alternate-number decision.
sourceBasis: PWS-MD-004B observed U-CUST-100 / Universaarl Kunde 100 on the real Customer Card.
The customer field map selected Saarland Maschinenbau AG as the realistic target first customer.
smartDecision.risk: Opening related pages may reveal missing context or navigation limits; any dialog that would change data must stop the run.
smartDecision.fallback: If dependencies cannot be proven read-only, keep the conversion write gate blocked and create a narrower UI discovery case.
